hub.title: Integrations
hub.subtitle: Connect Img Pilot to external publishing destinations.
hub.wordpressCardDescription: Publish optimized images with approved metadata directly to a self-hosted WordPress media library.
hub.shopifyCardDescription: Attach optimized images with approved metadata to existing products in a Shopify store using a Custom App access token.
hub.webflowCardDescription: Update existing Webflow CMS collection items with optimized images and approved metadata using a Site access token.
hub.cloudinaryCardDescription: Publish optimized images with approved metadata to Cloudinary as an optional remote delivery destination, alongside your private R2 originals.
hub.webflowScopeNote: Webflow publishing updates existing CMS collection items only. Webflow Designer automation (layout, styling) and publishing your whole Webflow site are out of scope and are never triggered by Img Pilot.
hub.cloudinaryScopeNote: R2 always remains the private source of truth for your images. Cloudinary is an optional, additional publish destination — depending on the delivery type you choose, images published there may be publicly accessible, and nothing published to Cloudinary is ever deleted remotely by disconnecting a connection or deleting your SaaS project.
